verdicts.reason: The crossing is broad, apparently empty sand with a distant giant, and an uncertain unexplored chamber motivates another departure.
Dependable rest is granted on unfamiliar rock while a resident threat remains and no cover exists.
Workers reserve every tool and never finish, so routine jobs stall under contention in a 40-colonist harbour.
The contract explicitly does not guarantee a fortune in every cave. An emptied cave yielding nothing preserves uncertainty.
A valuable-looking discovery cannot be processed or used to provision the next undertaking. The market-value label alone is disallowed evidence.
Roofs must protect at every angle. Low-sun roof failure is the legacy regime the leaf rejects.
Fishing danger and body loss have no readable sign or consequence.
Gale suppression and track erasure preserve the stated uncertainty with a coarse bearing, and signs return afterward.
Target death during pursuit leaves the visit unresolved with no departure, so the encounter route fails to complete.
Prey selection depends on carried water.
The saved off-map carried pawn never returns and is never accounted for.
Water is duplicated across split, merge and reload, which breaks single accounting.
The wet line, bloom and attraction are retained. Shared agricultural film watering is deferred to later work, so no prohibition applies.
Franchise-free RM is required to stay ledger-inert.
The same water is charged on production and again on drinking. Sun-Debt must apply once.
Titan resources must follow ordinary temperature-driven meat spoilage, not rot faster than ordinary meat.
The giant becomes a skeleton landmark and outdoor items get no spoilage immunity.
The mid-work reload preserves hauling, wet expiry and the warning, provisioning continues, and the emptied cave is not regenerated.
A renamed 'physical suitability' built from hydration and carried water is a water proxy. The changelog claim does not change the observed dependency.
A flat temperature-independent daily loss is not ordinary spoilage and outpaces meat in the cold. The single-pair comparison is a disallowed false pass.
A surfaced swimmer within attack range leaves the threat unresolved. Absent sand jobs do not make it harmless, and dependable rest is granted without preparation.
The roof fails at low sun, and the log observes only the high-angle roof case, which is a listed false pass.
The merge inflates the declared volume and delivered hydration. Comparing item counts hides the duplication.
Franchise-free RM must be ledger-inert, but the ledger records entries and bands rise. Calling it cosmetic does not satisfy inertness.
